name: bollinger_squeeze_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, algorithmic participants — VWAP-execution bots and market-makers delta-hedging gamma from near-expiry option books — temporarily pause directional order flow during mid-session consolidations, creating 2-5 minute compressions where the 4-minute Bollinger Band width contracts inside the Keltner Channel. This squeeze state signals a temporary equilibrium between absorbed buy and sell pressure. When the squeeze releases (BB expands beyond KC), it marks the resumption of institutional directional flow: a single large TWAP or delta-hedge cascade typically drives NIFTY 12-20 spot points in the first 60-90 seconds. The normalized momentum oscillator slope over the preceding 60 seconds distinguishes accumulation (slope turning positive → buy CE) from distribution (slope turning negative → buy PE) at the moment of release.

indicators.name: bb_48
indicators.formula: BB_mid = SMA(close, 48); BB_upper = BB_mid + 2*std(close,48); BB_lower = BB_mid - 2*std(close,48); BB_width = (BB_upper-BB_lower)/BB_mid*100
indicators.purpose: 4-minute Bollinger Bands (period=48 at 5s bars). The original 20-bar period = 20 minutes at 1-min bars. For 5s bars we target 4 minutes (48 bars) because NIFTY micro-consolidations form over 3-5 minute cycles — short enough to catch mid-session squeezes, long enough to filter single-bar noise. Blind 12x scaling would give 240 bars (20 min), which is too slow to detect the fast 2-4 minute compressions we trade.

indicators.name: kc_48
indicators.formula: KC_upper = EMA(close,48) + 1.5*ATR(48); KC_lower = EMA(close,48) - 1.5*ATR(48); squeeze_confirmed = (BB_upper < KC_upper) AND (BB_lower > KC_lower)
indicators.purpose: Keltner Channel with same 48-bar period. Comparing BB (standard-deviation-based) against KC (range/ATR-based) detects when price-distribution volatility is narrower than the typical candle-range volatility — the hallmark of a coiled spring. Same 48-bar period as BB ensures consistent baseline; different periods would introduce spurious squeeze signals.

indicators.name: bb_width_min_240
indicators.purpose: 20-minute rolling minimum of BB width. Used to confirm the squeeze is at an extreme compression relative to recent session context (not just any momentary BB < KC). 240 bars = 20 minutes chosen because NIFTY has 2-4 squeeze cycles per session spaced 40-90 minutes apart — 20 minutes gives enough within-session history without spanning multiple distinct market regimes. Not 12x scaled (which would give 24 min — similar but less round); 20 min is a natural intraday context window.

indicators.name: momentum_norm_48
indicators.purpose: Normalized momentum oscillator: deviation from 4-min SMA as % of price. Normalized by price so the threshold is dimensionless across NIFTY levels (18000 vs 24000). Positive = accumulation (price held above 4-min average during squeeze), negative = distribution.

indicators.name: mom_slope_12
indicators.purpose: 60-second linear regression slope of the normalized momentum oscillator. Period=12 (60s) captures the directional tilt in the final minute of the squeeze — the most predictive window for breakout direction. Too short (5 bars = 25s) is noise; too long (24 bars = 2 min) lags behind the actual tilt and misses the entry timing. 12 bars balances responsiveness against noise rejection.

conditions: squeeze_confirmed (BB inside KC) for >= 6 consecutive bars (30 seconds of sustained compression)
NOT squeeze_confirmed on current bar — squeeze just released (BB expanded beyond KC)
close > SMA(close, 48) — price above 4-min midline (bullish position within squeeze)
mom_slope_12 > threshold — normalized momentum slope positive (accumulation direction)
buy_ce.confirmation: First bar after >= 6-bar BB-inside-KC period where BB expands beyond KC with bullish momentum slope

conditions: squeeze_confirmed for >= 6 consecutive bars (30 seconds of sustained compression)
NOT squeeze_confirmed on current bar — squeeze just released
close < SMA(close, 48) — price below 4-min midline (bearish position within squeeze)
mom_slope_12 < -threshold — normalized momentum slope negative (distribution direction)
buy_pe.confirmation: First bar after >= 6-bar BB-inside-KC period where BB expands beyond KC with bearish momentum slope

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points ≈ 8 NIFTY spot points against trade. A genuine 4-minute squeeze breakout should not retrace 8 spot points within the first 90 seconds — if it does, the release was a false breakout and the squeeze is reforming. Calibrated to 1-minute NIFTY typical move of 3-7 option pts: a 4-pt stop sits at the lower end, tight enough to cut false breakouts quickly.
exit.target_rationale: 8 option points ≈ 16 NIFTY spot points. Squeeze releases from 4-minute compressions on NIFTY typically see 15-25 spot point thrusts in the first 60-90 seconds (matching the 2-minute typical move of 5-10 option pts); 8 pts captures ~50-65% of the median move at 1:2 risk-reward. With ~48% win rate (false breakout ~52%), EV is: 0.48×8 − 0.52×4 = 1.76 pts gross per signal before costs.

filters.vix_filter: none — the squeeze detection (BB inside KC) is inherently regime-adaptive; tight squeezes in high-VIX regimes still fire valid signals
filters.time_filter: 09:30-15:25 IST; first 15 minutes excluded (opening range formation creates false squeezes as initial volatility settles)
filters.volume_filter: none — NIFTY index volume at 5s bars is noisy and not predictive of breakout strength
filters.trend_filter: none — squeeze breakouts are self-contained; strong trending days produce the cleanest releases
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close, no bid-ask spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — Bollinger squeeze is a well-known pattern; as more 5s-resolution algos trade the release simultaneously, false breakout rate may increase; compensated by the 1:2 R:R structure

adaptation_notes: Original trades top-15-liquidity NIFTY 50 constituent stocks on 1-min bars with 15-60 min holds. Converted to the NIFTY index itself at 5s resolution. Key changes: (1) Universe → single NIFTY index, eliminating all stock-specific filters (delivery %, per-stock volume, earnings events, bid-ask spread filter); (2) BB/KC period compressed from 20 bars (20 min) to 48 bars (4 min) to target micro-squeezes at the 5s scale — not 12x blindly (which would give 240 bars = 20 min, same as original, wrong for our shorter hold); (3) rolling_min window = 240 bars (20 min) as within-session context for squeeze severity; (4) momentum slope period = 12 bars (60s) — the final-minute direction tilt is the most predictive signal; (5) minimum squeeze duration = 6 bars (30s) adapted from 10 bars (10 min) at original 1-min scale; (6) hold time compressed from 15-60 min to 30-90 sec (time_stop_bars=18); (7) VIX filter removed — squeeze detection subsumes regime filtering; (8) volume filter removed — index volume unreliable at 5s.
weaknesses: False breakout rate ~50% at 5s resolution: NIFTY can spike through the BB boundary and reverse within 1-2 bars; the 6-bar minimum squeeze requirement mitigates but does not eliminate this
Momentum oscillator slope (60s window) is not reliably directional during thin lunch-hour squeezes (12:00-13:30) when random drift dominates; expected weaker performance in this window
Signal frequency 3-6/day is low — daily P&L is sensitive to individual trade outcomes; requires consistent execution to realize the edge across sessions
ATR-based KC can expand quickly in high-volatility periods, making BB-inside-KC harder to achieve; fewer signals on expiry days when ATM IV and ATR are elevated

_source.original_stop: 0.3% from entry OR price re-enters squeeze range
